description: Winterfall Firewater: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This vial that you picked up from the Winterfall furbolg is empty, but you can detect a few drops of a strange green liquid inside; it almost glows.
Donova Snowden would probably be able to tell you more, since she has been camped by the hot springs in Winterspring for some time now.
